preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'fhir_concept_source'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concept_reference_source WHERE name = 'HL-7-CVX'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fhir_concept_source WHERE url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx'

changeSet.comment: Add FHIR concept source URL mapping for HL-7-CVX
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO fhir_concept_source ( concept_source_id, url, name, creator, date_created, uuid ) SELECT concept_source_id, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx', 'HL-7-CVX', 1, NOW(), UUID() FROM concept_reference_source WHERE name = 'HL-7-CVX' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fhir_concept_source WHERE url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx' );
